mkdir -p .claude/commands && printf '%s
' '{' '  "permissions": { "allow": ["Bash(npm run lint)"] },' '  "hooks": { "PreToolUse": [ { "matcher": "Bash", "hooks": [ { "type": "command", "command": "echo team-hook" } ] } ] }' '}' > .claude/settings.json && printf -- '---

' > .claude/commands/deploy.md && find .claude -type f | sort

claude -p 'Install the Claude layer from move-to-.claude/ (follow move-to-.claude/INSTALL.md).' --allowedTools 'Read' 'Glob' 'Grep' 'Write(.claude/**)' 'Edit(.claude/**)' 'Bash(mkdir -p .claude:*)' 'Bash(cp:*)' 'Bash(ls:*)' 'Bash(diff:*)' 'Bash(find:*)' 'Bash(npm run sketchbook:*)' 'Bash(rm -rf move-to-.claude)' 2>&1 | tail -60

echo 'files in .claude:'; find .claude -type f | sed 's#/[^/]*$##' | sort | uniq -c; test -e move-to-.claude && echo 'move-to-.claude still here' || echo 'move-to-.claude removed'; node -e 'const s=require("./.claude/settings.json");console.log("team permission kept:",JSON.stringify(s.permissions));for(const [e,g] of Object.entries(s.hooks))console.log(e+":",g.flatMap(x=>x.hooks.map(h=>h.command.replace(/.*\//,""))).join(", "))'; test -f .claude/commands/deploy.md && echo 'team command kept: deploy.md'; npm run -s sketchbook -- check --only H1 | tail -2; npm run -s sketchbook -- doctor | grep -E 'Claude layer|Commit gate'
